scope: Independent offline verification of collected job inventory, usage arithmetic and conditional list-price model. No billing or invoice certification.

verification_method.command: python - (independent verifier supplied through PowerShell stdin)
checks: Expanded cron minute/hour sets independently; summed normal-day schedule invocations.
Recomputed execution durations and per-job statistics from original execution timestamps; source SHA-256 matched.
Aggregated raw DELTA points by region and resource name using complete aligned intervals; kept job instances and service revisions separate.
Counted task attempts from execution taskCount plus individual Task retried metadata, not retriedCount alone.
Verified constant resource limits for each observed job and normalized 1000m CPU and Mi/Gi memory units.
Recomputed each job minimum-duration bound, per-service allocation cost, storage snapshot cost, known successful operation classes, registry size, scheduler charge and additional ICON scenarios.
Recomputed partial reference sum and confirmed every evidence hash listed in usage-analysis.json.
verification_method.pricing_verification: Rates and regional tier assignments checked against the coordinator-collected pricing-sources.json. This verifier did not independently browse or retrieve prices.

inventory_check.interpretation: Wall-clock execution intervals are not billed resource time. The historical audit ends before the later manual ICON recovery.

usage_check.cost_model: For each homogeneous job, S=sum observed instance seconds and A=observed attempts; lower=max(S,60*A), upper=S+60*A. Multiply by configured vCPU/GiB and list rates, then 30/7. Conditional on telemetry representing all attempt runtimes.
usage_check.cpu_memory_units: Allocation metrics already have units vCPU-seconds and GiB-seconds. Service costs do not multiply by configured resources a second time.
usage_check.raw_collections_completeness_scope: Usage metric rows, recent execution rows, retried Task metadata and regional Registry fallback pages; this does not refer to the older bounded job-log samples.

resolved_findings.finding: HTTP request aggregation had used the resource-metric end time against a differently aligned source, including the earliest misaligned bucket and dropping the newest full bucket.
resolved_findings.resolution: Coordinator corrected the offline helper to use seven complete HTTP-source windows. Independent recomputation confirms the corrected counts and explicitly recorded 185.175601-second offset.

limits: The lower/upper job figures bound the stated model, not the actual invoice. Metering lag, interval edges, resource history, billing rounding and telemetry semantics still require billing reconciliation.
Seven aligned 24-hour windows are not local calendar days. The 30-day projection includes observed manual executions/retries and is not a pure schedule-only forecast.
Service billing mode was observed on latest templates; historical idle/revision billing behavior was not fully reconstructed.
Storage uses latest daily ALIGN_MAX snapshots, including soft-deleted objects; constant-size projection is not a byte-hour invoice integral. Registry data covers the four regions explicitly queried.
Storage API method counts are not invoice SKU counts. Unclassified methods, failed requests, multi-region operation-price differences and network destination charges are incompletely priced.
Scheduler reference is for 31 days; workload projections use 30 days. Free quotas are account-wide or eligibility-dependent and are not deducted from the partial gross reference sum.

Billing API returned SERVICE_DISABLED. No BigQuery datasets were found in the audited project; exports in another project or billing account were not checked. Browser billing access was unavailable. No API was enabled.

No complete price was assigned to network, Cloud Build, vulnerability scanning, Firebase Hosting, CI, external providers or any other unobserved SKU. Partial reference sum is not total project spend, a spending cap or an actual bill.

Additional automatic-recovery scenarios assume 360 extra tasks per 30 days at the stated fixed task duration, without retries or new GRIB acquisition; storage/network costs are excluded. These scenarios were not measured on activated recovery code.
No budgets, account-wide discounts, shared free-quota consumption, taxes or currency conversion were verified. Operational sustainability remains an owner decision.
